name: submission_reference
description: Unique reference of the onboarding submission. Format is the four letters HCSO, a hyphen, the submission date in the form year month day, a hyphen, and eight upper case hexadecimal characters.

name: submission_received_timestamp
description: Instant at which the Django REST Framework application accepted the submission. This column is the partitioning column of the table.

name: student_given_name
description: Given name of the student. Withheld from the reporting view.

name: student_family_name
description: Family name of the student. Withheld from the reporting view.

name: student_date_of_birth
description: Date of birth of the student. Withheld from the reporting view.

name: student_year_group
description: National curriculum year group of the student, from one to thirteen inclusive.

name: parent_or_guardian_full_name
description: Full name of the parent or guardian making the submission. Withheld from the reporting view.

name: parent_or_guardian_email_address
description: Electronic mail address of the parent or guardian. Withheld from the reporting view.

name: parent_or_guardian_telephone_number
description: Telephone number of the parent or guardian in international format. Withheld from the reporting view.

name: home_postal_code
description: Postal code of the home address of the student. Withheld from the reporting view.

name: assigned_local_authority_name
description: Name of the local authority responsible for the student. This column is a clustering column and is the column that the row access policy filters on.

name: school_unique_reference_number
description: Six digit unique reference number of the school that the student attends.

name: learning_support_category
description: Category of learning support requested. One of the six permitted values held in the deconstructed yes or no validation library. This column is a clustering column.

name: weekly_support_hours_requested
description: Number of support hours requested each week, from one to twenty five inclusive.

name: preferred_session_language
description: Language in which the support sessions are to be delivered. One of the permitted values held in the deconstructed yes or no validation library.

name: education_health_care_plan_is_present
description: True when the student holds an education, health and care plan. When true the reference column must be populated.

name: education_health_care_plan_reference
description: Reference of the education, health and care plan. Null exactly when the plan is not present.

name: data_processing_consent_is_given
description: True when the parent or guardian has given explicit consent to the processing of the data of the student. A submission with this column set to false is never written to this table.

name: validation_outcome_is_accepted
description: Overall outcome of the deconstructed yes or no validation library. True only when every rule answered yes.

name: validation_rule_results
description: One entry for each rule evaluated by the deconstructed yes or no validation library, preserved so that an audit can reconstruct exactly why a submission was accepted.

fields.name: rule_identifier
fields.description: Stable identifier of the validation rule.

fields.name: rule_question
fields.description: The question that the rule answers, stated so that the only possible answers are yes and no.

fields.name: rule_answer_is_yes
fields.description: The answer that the rule returned for this submission.

name: record_is_withheld_from_analytics
description: True when the parent or guardian has objected to analytical processing. The row access policy and the reporting view both exclude rows where this column is true.

name: ingestion_source_object_path
description: Full path of the object in the raw landing bucket from which this row was derived, retained so that every row can be traced back to its source.
